Thanks for taking this — we’re excited to get CloudBridge listed and transactable via Redwood on the marketplaces. Procurement asked me to confirm the exact steps you need from our side to be activated as a vendor across AWS/GCP/Azure. A few specific items they flagged:

Hi Maya 9

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. High-level next steps below — I’ll loop in Laura from Finance to handle the PO and remit details and Karthik for marketplace setup specifics.

1) Vendor form + DocuSign: please complete the attached Vendor-Onboarding-Form.docx and sign the vendor agreement we’ll send via DocuSign: https://docusign.net/EnvelopeID/3b9f79c2
2) W-9 & EIN: yes, we need a completed W-9 and legal entity name + EIN exactly as it should appear on invoices. You can upload to the secure HubSpot document link on the deal or send to billing@redwood.ai.
3) PO routing & template: attached is our preferred Redwood_PO_Template.docx. For purchase orders, please ask your procurement team to route POs to billing@redwood.ai and include the HubSpot deal id DB-2027-0949 in the PO number field so we can match automatically.
4) Marketplace specifics:
   - AWS: we support both transactable listings and consolidated billing ("seller-managed"). For fastest time-to-revenue, transactable is easiest but requires SKU mapping in Seller Central; Karthik will advise on the SKU mapping and seller-id fields.
   - GCP Marketplace: generally consolidated invoicing via resellers is common; we can accept either and will surface the appropriate billing info once vendor is onboarded.
   - Azure Marketplace: typically requires marketplace registration + PubID; again Karthik can coordinate.

Estimated timeline once we have completed form, W-9, and the signed DocuSign: 7-10 business days to be fully visible in our internal vendor registry and to finish marketplace SKU mapping. If you want a test PO earlier we can provision a test vendor entry within 48 hours after receipt of the W-9 + completed form.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.docx, Vendor-Onboarding-Form.docx

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales (Marketplace Partnerships)
Redwood Inference

Adding a few finance ops items to speed processing on our side: please confirm the following on the vendor form or in a reply so we can build your vendor profile in our ERP.

Required fields for vendor record:
- Legal company name (as on W-9)
- DBA (if different)
- EIN/TIN
- Billing remit-to address (street, city, state, zip)
- Remit email for invoices (we prefer billing@cloudbridge.com or a dedicated AP mailbox)
- Invoice cadence (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) and PO requirement (yes/no)
- Contact name for AP escalations and phone number

Please also: 
- Attach a signed W-9 (you included it, thank you) to the HubSpot deal or send to billing@redwood.ai. For security, please avoid sending W-9s to personal email addresses.
- If you need a custom PO routing note for AWS Marketplace purchases, let us know the exact text your procurement uses and we’ll confirm acceptance.

Example PO line (copy to your procurement team):

Bill To: Redwood Inference (Remit: billing@redwood.ai)
Ship/Delivery: N/A (digital software)
Amount: as invoiced per transactable purchase

If you can confirm the above today, I’ll kick off the vendor setup and request the internal finance approval for the test PO.

Thanks,
